title: Shebitku
summary: King listed in CFAH-10 Table 9 (Egypt Dynasty 25 (Cushite)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 25 (Cushite). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-10 (Table 9, "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 25"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Reign: 12; Start: 713; End: 701). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-10: The Libyan-Cushite Intermediate Period," OSF preprint v1.4 (26 Dec 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/FG4DV, file CFAH-10 The Libyan-Cushite Intermediate Period_v1.4.pdf, Table 9 "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 25", p. 28
